verdict.rationale: Probes found no downloadable machine-readable spec. All standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404 (bolna-probe-2). The llms.txt-declared /docs/api-reference/openapi.yml and its .yaml/.json variants also return 404, and the GitHub repo carries no spec file (bolna-spec-declared-404-20261106). The interactive Mintlify 'Try it' playground and the cURL samples are adjacent features, not a downloadable spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
